release.reason: The lifecycle profile delivers helper source through a draft PR; this core slice publishes no separately versioned artifact.

deploy.reason: This isolated core slice does not install the helper, enroll live cycles, or change any managed environment; dependent rollout owns profile-required deployment.

operate.reason: No live continuation runtime is enabled by this core slice; only disposable conformance fixtures run. Dependent adapter and rollout slices require live recovery evidence.
